processing.evidence: polymerized at room temperature for 20 min

youngs_modulus.evidence: Shear storage moduli (G0 ) of the fibrin gels and Matrigel are similar and all range from 45 to 125 Pascals (Pa)

stability.conditions: seeded with mouse spinal cord neurons in culture

biology.cell_type: Primary mouse spinal cord (E13.5), mouse cortical (E13.5) and rat cortical (E18) neurons

culture_days.evidence: Unless otherwise stated, neurite length was measured after 3 days culture in the gels.

other_outcomes.evidence: Removal of the adhesion molecule FN from salmon fibrin decreases total neurite length per cell by 35%
other_outcomes.name: decrease in total neurite length per cell upon FN removal

other_outcomes.evidence: total neurite length per cell was reduced 35% with depletion of FN and 66% with echistatin treatment
other_outcomes.name: decrease in total neurite length per cell with echistatin treatment

notes: Gels 8 mm diameter, 3 mm height. Modulus measured without cells at 2% strain, 10 rad/s; range given for all gels collectively. Salmon fibrin gave the longest neurites.
